caption: The image shows a large ceramic pitcher with a wide body and a pronounced spout. The pitcher is primarily light in color, likely white or cream, with darker decorations and accents. There are two thick horizontal bands near the top and bottom of the pitcher, rendered in a dark tone, possibly black or deep brown. The central decorative element on the vessel’s front is an oval wreath composed of symmetrical leaves and ribbons, within which the words "PEACE and PROSPERITY to AMERICA" are inscribed in capital and small letters. The text and wreath are in the same dark color as the bands. Additional floral or foliage motifs embellish the area around the wreath, extending outward symmetrically. On the upper neck and around the lip of the pitcher, a broad dark band serves as an additional highlight. There is a partial figure of a person, drawn in outline, on the right-hand side of the pitcher, partially visible in the image. The background is plain and neutral, and the pitcher is set on a flat surface.
title: Jug - "Peace and Prosperity"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
